turns.content: The migration exists but tests/conftest.py builds the test schema from a stale metadata snapshot instead of running migrations, so the new column never shows up under test. Making the fixture run `alembic upgrade head` before yielding the engine.
user_sessions is created by a later migration the fixture wasn't stamping past. Upgrading to head instead of a single revision fixes it; the suite is green now.
